_note: Every number the deck states in its DOM copy that is not a bare repetition of one word of prose. A figure the SOURCE wrote is declared with quoted_from and the exact string it came out of. A figure this run's own code produced is declared with computed_by, naming the script and the input, so anybody can re-run it. Nothing here was typed from memory. The figures drawn inside the SVG instruments on frames 2, 7 and 8 are declared in the storyboard's own `numerals` blocks and computed in out/2026-09-15/compute.py, because this gate reads DOM text and does not see them.

aggregates.computed_by: out/2026-09-15/compute.py mitigations_in_force and mitigations_not_in_force, which partition the same three status cells by a stated test
aggregates.note: THE READING IS THE DECK'S OWN ARGUMENT AND IS PRESENTED AS THE DECK'S. ERCOT does not say its three mitigations sit at three stages.
